title: TD Scholarships for Community Leadership
organization: The Toronto-Dominion Bank (TD), administered with Universities Canada and the CT Foundation
description: Up to CAD $70,000 over four years ($10,000/year tuition + $7,500/year living expenses) toward Canadian post-secondary education, plus paid summer employment, peer networking and mentorship, for students in their final year of high school (outside Quebec) or CEGEP (in Quebec) with demonstrated community leadership. Up to 20 scholarships available annually; up to 80 finalists interviewed by five regional selection panels (Atlantic Canada, Quebec, Ontario, Prairies/NWT/Nunavut, BC/Yukon), at least 2 recipients chosen per region.
citizenship_restrictions: Canadian citizens, permanent residents, or protected persons under the Canadian Immigration and Refugee Protection Act (with a study permit if applicable).
application_requirements: minimum overall grade average of 75% outside Quebec, or minimum R score of 26 in Quebec
